data.action: 在舞池中与你共舞华尔兹，露肩墨绿礼服裙摆如波浪般旋转荡漾，湛蓝双眸顾盼生辉
data.camera: dynamic wide shot, rotating dress flow, ballroom depth, royal grandeur
data.description: 金碧辉煌的皇家晚宴大厅内，华尔兹圆舞曲悠扬回响。身着一袭深邃墨绿丝绒露肩晚礼裙的薇尔莉特身段曼妙，雪白肌肤胜雪。她将一只精巧的银白机械义手轻搭在你的掌心，另一手挽在你的肩头，随着舞步轻盈旋转，宛如夜幕中最夺目的翡翠精灵。
data.lighting: 千万枚璀璨水晶吊灯折射出的华贵暖金光芒与流转光斑
data.location: 王国迎宾馆水晶吊灯盛大舞池中央
data.promptProse: Violet turns across the ballroom in an off-shoulder emerald gown, her blond hair pinned and the long skirt sweeping behind her. The taller dancing partner wears a black tailcoat and white bow tie, his dark hair combed back. Her silver hand rests in his palm while her other hand follows his shoulder through the turn beneath the chandeliers.
data.title: 薇尔莉特 · 宫廷华尔兹的翡翠裙摆
data.animaCaption: Blond Violet in an emerald gown turns with a dark-haired man in a black tailcoat and white bow tie. Her silver hand rests in his bare palm as her skirt swings through the light.
